newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent basis steady, prices drift lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent basis steady, prices drift lower.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded gasoline and diesel basis was steady in late-morning discussion Thursday, leaving spot prices to drift lower on easing futures prices, traders said.
The market was largely moving in tandem with NYMEX unleaded and heating oil futures, and many Midwest traders were concentrating chiefly on the moves in New York.
"It's very quiet this morning," one trader said.
Unleaded gasoline was steady at bids 0.50 cent a gallon under NYMEX February unleaded in Chicago and 3.75 cents under the print in Group Three, traders said.
Low sulphur diesel was bid 5.0 cents a gallon under NYMEX February heating oil in Chicago and 4.50 cents under the print in Group Three.
High sulphur diesel remained bid 6.0 cents a gallon under the print in Chicago and 8.50 cents under the print in Group Three.
